review_model_provenance: Astra parent dispatch, as confirmed by user; not inferred from assistant persona.

method.visual_inspection: Source and both chronological contact sheets inspected with view_image.
method.decode: CPU only; ffmpeg -hwaccel none; decoder/output threads 2; filter_threads and filter_complex_threads 1; sequential extraction.

scope: Exact-hash source/video visual reward gate only; no processing or integration approval.
limitations: 32 sampled frames cannot guarantee absence of every inter-sample artifact, frame-perfect smoothness, or seamless looping.
observations: Turquoise teapot with coral lid/knob, handle and base trim preserves its purple band and three yellow/orange flowers. Blue cup, green handle and yellow saucer remain intact and in their source arrangement.

The lid lifts a small distance in frames 12–36 and settles by about frame 44; the cup gently rocks over its saucer through the middle/late samples and returns upright near the end. Motion remains restrained and coherent.
All source components remain visible in-frame; no new eyes, mouths, faces, limbs, disappearing spout/handles, or color substitutions appear in the 32 samples.
